name: Because I ████ You
source:
Police detective, Silas Wright, has been assigned to a recent serial killer case with Jane Delaver.

Normally, that'd be no issue for him. This time however, he's working with practically nothing besides each victim having two puncture wounds on the neck like a snake bite.

In his free time, he spends his time going out with a guy he met recently. It's been nice, something to take his mind off of all the stress of his work.. but it's beginning to feel more and more connected to his case than he would've liked...

[From [url=https://nameless-entity.itch.io/because-i-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
警探塞拉斯·赖特 (Silas Wright) 被指派调查最近与简·德拉弗 (Jane Delaver) 一起的连环杀手案件。

正常情况下，这对他来说不是什么问题。然而这一次，除了每个受害者脖子上都有两处刺伤（就像被蛇咬伤一样）外，他几乎什么也没处理。

在空闲时间，他会和最近认识的一个人出去玩。这很好，可以让他从工作的所有压力中解脱出来……但他开始感觉这与他的案子的联系越来越多，超出了他的预期……

[来自[url=https://nameless-entity.itch.io/because-i-you]itch.io[/url]]
